spans.s: दयानन्दसरस्वति a brilliant Vedic scholar of the nineteenth century belonging to North India who established on a sound footing the study of the Vedas and Vyakarana and encouraged the study of Kasikavrtti. He has written many books on vedic studies.
दयापाल a.Jain writer who wrote a treatise named रूपसिद्धि.
दयारत्न a.Jain scholar who has written a grammar treatise on the Saras- vata Grammar called सारस्वतपरिभाषा. दयाराम writer of a commentary on the Mugdhabodha Vyakarana of Bopadeva.
